summary: Iteration 4 testing of bilingual IT/DE, weekly plan print/share, markdown rendering and full regression. Backend: 40/40 existing pytest regression pass; new suite test_iter4_lang.py = 10/12 pass (2 failures: vision lang='de' returns Italian). Frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844): language switcher, localStorage persistence, full UI translation, weekly print/share with live doses, recipe CRUD/duplicate/scale, oven profile CRUD, production plan compute+persist, announcements CRUD with delete confirm/cancel all PASS. Two real defects found: (1) photo vision ignores lang='de', (2) markdown rendering broken by SSE newline loss (lists not rendered, raw '##'/'**'/'---' leaking).

critical.issue: lang='de' still returns ITALIAN analysis (reproduced 2x for mode='difetti' and 'ingredienti'). RCA: VISION_PROMPTS strings end with 'Rispondi in italiano, ...' (server.py L466/472) which conflicts with the appended LANG_DIRECTIVE, and the Italian instruction wins. Fix: remove the hardcoded 'Rispondi in italiano' from both prompts (and ideally localize the whole vision prompt per lang) so LANG_DIRECTIVE is authoritative.

minor.issue: Prior-turn context is injected with hardcoded Italian labels ('Conversazione precedente', 'Utente', 'Maestro') regardless of lang; can bias multi-turn German conversations back to Italian.

ui_bugs.issue: AI markdown renders partially: headings/strong appear but lists render as inline text and raw '##'/'**'/'---' are visible (caused by SSE newline loss above)
With DE selected the request correctly sends lang:'de' but the returned analysis is in Italian (backend defect)
Load-failure toast is hardcoded Italian 'Errore nel caricamento' (WeeklyPlan.jsx L47) - not translated

issues: bake-time-input is a native datetime-local picker (renders as mm/dd/yyyy US format), not a localized/shadcn date-time control; date format does not follow the selected language
Seeded announcement titles/bodies remain Italian when DE is selected (DB-stored seed data, not UI strings) - consider bilingual seeds

action_items: Remove 'Rispondi in italiano' from VISION_PROMPTS (server.py) so lang='de' produces German vision output; optionally localize vision prompts per language
Fix SSE payload encoding (JSON-encode deltas backend + parse frontend) so markdown paragraphs/lists survive streaming and no raw '##'/'**' leaks
Translate WeeklyPlan load-error toast via t()
Localize maestro_stream conversation-context labels per lang
critical_code_review_comments: SSE protocol is not newline-safe: any model delta containing \n\n silently loses content structure. Must encode payloads.
Prompt language control is split between LANG_DIRECTIVE and hardcoded per-prompt language instructions -> conflicting instructions; keep a single source of truth.
translations.js it/de key parity verified (171/171 keys, no missing keys, only 3 intentionally identical values).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all flows work; markdown rendering + DE vision output defective)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_ data only: recipe 'TEST_DE Brot' (+duplicate), oven profile 'TEST_DE Ofen', announcement 'TEST_DE Ankündigung', temporary weekly-plan items. Baseline restored: 3 mikilab recipes, 0 personal, 0 oven profiles, 2 seeded announcements, empty weekly plan. NOTE: production-plan doc now stores bake time 2026-07-20T07:00 with phase0=3h (was previously saved test data too).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (52 tests incl. test_iter4_lang.py). The 2 known failures are TestVisionLang::test_vision_difetti_de and test_vision_ingredienti_de (language directive overridden by Italian prompt). For markdown verification, assert rendered tags in [data-testid="chat-msg-assistant"]/[data-testid="photo-result"] contain ul/li and that inner_text has no '##'/'**'. Weekly print can be verified by monkeypatching window.open and capturing document.write output; empty plan shows warning toast and never calls window.open. Language switcher verified via localStorage key mikilab_lang.
rca_of_the_issue:
1) Vision language: VISION_PROMPTS end with 'Rispondi in italiano...'; LANG_DIRECTIVE ' Antworte IMMER auf Deutsch' is appended after but the model follows the domain-specific Italian instruction, so DE requests return Italian (reproduced twice via API and once via UI). 2) Markdown: backend yields 'data: <raw delta>

'; deltas contain newlines including blank lines, so frontend buffer.split('

') treats them as frame boundaries and discards the blank lines, collapsing markdown block separation -> remark cannot parse lists/headings, raw markers leak.
